title: Alam kiska hai
body:
dabdaba kiska hashm kiska alam kiska hai
mere ghazi ke muqabil ho ye dam kiska hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen waale usay toote dilon ki aas kehte hai
shariyat mein usay sadaat ka ehsaan kehte hai
karam sabr o raza ki saltanat ka naam hai shabbir
wafa ki aakhri sarhad ko hum abbas kehte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna to kahin ay dil ye payambar to nahi
sardar e fatema zehra pe ye kham kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
hur ne ek pal mein shifa'at ki sanad paayi hai
shab e ashoor ye andaz e karam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
sawaal e ajr e risalat maaf hona hai
munafiqat ko abhi be-naqaab hona hai
ali ka beta zamane mein aane waala hai
abhi to baagh e fidak ka hisaab hona hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ye kehte ho fidak haq hai nabi zaadi ka
hum ye kehte hai arab aur ajam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq ko zinda kiya aulad e abu talib ne
warna tareekh e shuja'at mein bharam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunnat e ahmed e mukhtaar hai shabbir ka gham
is hawaale se zara soch ye gham kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag ye kisne lagayi hai dar e zehra par
tu hi tareekh batade ye sitam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jahan waale jise mohr e nabuwat samjhe
dosh e ahmed pe muhib naqshe qadam kiska hai
dabdaba kiska...
author: Mohib Fazli
